changelog.change: Loading screens and the transitions between areas are now removed from Game Time, on by default. Turn it off in the Timer tab to match the game's own number exactly.
The timer starts on a new game and not before: sitting on the menu no longer starts it, and continuing a save leaves it alone.
Quitting to the menu mid-run no longer splits on the area of your last save.
Restarting a run no longer held the new attempt's clock at zero for the loading time removed from earlier attempts.
The Debug tab now shows the raw clock, the time sent to LiveSplit, and how much loading was removed.
A run now ends on the ending you choose rather than on the elder's death — the default route's last split is ending:any.
New ending: trigger, taking 1, 2 or any, for splitting on which of the two endings a run took.
New End presets: Any ending, Ending 1, Ending 2, Credits roll, and Post-credits for 100 % routes.
Ships as a single DLL: one file to copy into LiveSplit's Components folder.
In-game time driven into LiveSplit's Game Time, read from the game's memory with nothing installed into the game folder.
Auto-splitting on a configurable trigger language over flags, skills, collectibles, activations and scenes.
The active scene is read live, so scene: splits fire at the door rather than at the next save.
